tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Clarity Today stories about a subject. Returns up to 12 matching stories, newest first, each with its URL and how many independent publishers back it. Pass a result’s id to fetch to read the whole story.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one Clarity Today story in full, as Markdown: what happened, why it matters, what to watch, the claim ledger tying each claim to its source, and every publisher the story draws on.

tools.name: get_todays_briefing
tools.description: Today’s Briefing: the handful of stories Clarity’s desks ranked most important right now, each with its key verified points.

tools.name: list_latest_stories
tools.description: The newest Clarity Today stories, newest first: across every desk, or from one desk.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
